definitions.explanation: A strong thick line made of twisted fibers or strands.
The sacred rope worn by yokozuna (grand champion) in sumo wrestling.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}を{綱|つな}でつないだ。
examples.english: I tied the boat with a rope.

examples.japanese: {命|いのち}の{綱|つな}だと{思|おも}って{離|はな}さなかった。
examples.english: I held on tight, believing it was my lifeline.

notes:
{綱|つな} means rope or cord, typically thicker than {紐|ひも} (string).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {綱引|つなひ}き (tug-of-war)
- {命|いのち}の{綱|つな} (lifeline)
- {綱渡|つなわた}り (tightrope walking; risky situation)
- {横綱|よこづな} (yokozuna, sumo grand champion)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {紐|ひも} (string, thin cord)
- {縄|なわ} (rope, cord - similar to {綱|つな})
- ロープ (rope - loanword)

COUNTER: {本|ほん}
